title: Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a zesty Mediterranean blend, grilled to perfection. Perfect for a warm evening or as a show-stopping centerpiece for your next gathering.

ingredients.name: Lamb Shoulder, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: High-quality oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Fresh Oregano
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh oregano for added zing

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Don't be shy, use more if you love garlic

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade, whatever you have on hand

ingredients.name: Wooden Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak them in water for 30 minutes before grilling

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, oregano, garlic, lemon juice, and Mediterranean seasoning.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the lamb onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh parsley or oregano, if desired.
Serve immediately, hot off the grill.
